body:
EmilyOS commit 6710f33. Confirmed the framebuffer-console theory from the prior pass directly via QEMU's QMP screendump command (no VNC client needed) instead of leaving it a guess: real kernel boot text confirmed going to the framebuffer, invisible to headless serial-only tests. Built a real, throwaway root-less test image (the same boot.img this session's script produces + a tiny synthetic ext4 root partition) and booted it under qemu-system-aarch64 -M raspi3b with -drive if=sd (found and fixed a real QEMU constraint along the way: SD images must be a power-of-2 size). Definitive, screendump-captured result (saved at docs/pi-boot-test-switch-root-panic.png): switch_root correctly finds and mounts /dev/mmcblk0p2, transitions into it, and correctly panics trying to exec /sbin/init (which the synthetic root deliberately doesn't have) -- exactly the right failure for that test, and definitive proof every real piece of the boot pipeline (cmdline.txt's root=, partition layout, mount, switch_root) works end to end. The one class of risk that would have been hardest to debug after a failed real privileged attempt (a silently wrong boot config) is now retired with positive evidence.

⚓ ☃
title: Definitive root-less proof: the EmilyOS Pi image boot pipeline works end to end
